boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-purchase outings for Juniata students, from campus art and recreation to public stargazing and a nearby state-park picnic.

cards.title: Browse the Museum Galleries
cards.subtitle: Free art viewing inside Carnegie Hall
cards.notes: Meet in Carnegie Hall and browse the current exhibitions together; check the museum page for semester or summer hours first.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission gallery outing centered on rotating exhibitions and Juniata’s collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata states that the museum has free admission and serves campus and local communities through exhibitions in Carnegie Hall.
cards.source_title: Juniata College Museum of Art Opens Two New Exhibitions Celebrating History and Creativity
cards.access_notes: Free admission. Regular hours vary between the academic semester and summer; verify the museum schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Share a Telescope at Observatory Night
cards.subtitle: Free public stargazing behind Brumbaugh Academic Center
cards.notes: Bring friends, dress for the weather, and follow the red lights uphill; confirm the posted date and cancellation notice before leaving.
cards.short_summary: An open-house evening for viewing seasonal celestial objects through college telescopes.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata says its Observatory Nights are free and open to everyone, welcome all ages, and require no preregistration.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to everyone with no preregistration. Events are weather-dependent and canceled for clouds, rain, or snow; consult the page for current dates.

cards.title: Plan a Recreation-Center Session
cards.subtitle: Student fitness and indoor recreation at no added charge
cards.notes: Choose a workout or court activity with classmates, carry your Juniata ID, and confirm the facility’s current open hours before meeting.
cards.short_summary: A student-only indoor hang built around shared exercise and recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata’s international student handbook identifies the Kennedy Sports and Recreation Center as free for all students and lists its pool, fitness center, and courts.
cards.access_notes: Free for Juniata students. Bring a college ID and verify current hours and facility availability before going.

cards.title: Walk to the Peace Chapel
cards.subtitle: A public, self-guided woodland destination by Maya Lin
cards.notes: Start at the marked entrance off Warm Springs Avenue, walk the trail as a group, and leave the stone installation undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A quiet woodland walk ending at Maya Lin’s two-part environmental artwork.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata identifies the Peace Chapel as open to the public and accessible by marked walking trails, establishing no-admission public access.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public via marked walking trails. This is an outdoor woodland site; visit in suitable weather and daylight conditions.

cards.title: Trade Reflections at the Outdoor Library
cards.subtitle: Free reading resources beside the Peace Chapel parking area
cards.notes: Pause by the parking-area library, select a free peace or interfaith resource, and discuss it together without blocking the trailhead.
cards.short_summary: A conversation-friendly reading stop paired with a Peace Chapel outing.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata states that the outdoor library near the Peace Chapel parking area offers free copies of interfaith prayer and peace resources.
cards.access_notes: The listed reading copies are free. The library is outdoors near the Peace Chapel parking area and may be affected by weather or supply availability.

cards.title: Take a Riparian-Buffer Walk
cards.subtitle: A campus nature walk at the east end of campus
cards.notes: Meet at the east end of campus, follow the established walking area, and keep the group together while observing plants and wildlife.
cards.short_summary: A low-key campus walk through a named streamside landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata’s official wellbeing resource identifies the Riparian Buffer at the east end of campus as an available peaceful nature walk, with no admission or purchase listed.
cards.access_notes: Presented by Juniata as an outdoor campus wellbeing space with no admission or purchase requirement. Use established paths and visit in appropriate weather.

cards.entity_name: Brumbaugh Academic Center Disc Golf Course
cards.title: Play a Casual Disc-Golf Round
cards.subtitle: Campus course on the hill behind Brumbaugh Academic Center
cards.notes: Bring discs you already own or borrow them from a friend, form a small group, and yield to pedestrians and other course users.
cards.short_summary: A no-fee campus round suited to a relaxed group meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata lists a disc golf course behind Brumbaugh Academic Center among its available outdoor wellbeing spaces, without an admission requirement.
cards.access_notes: No admission is listed for the outdoor campus course. Playing for zero dollars assumes participants bring or borrow discs rather than purchase equipment.

cards.title: Walk the Labyrinth Together
cards.subtitle: An outdoor reflection path beside Statton Learning Commons
cards.notes: Meet outside Statton, take turns following the circular path to its center and back, then compare what each person noticed.
cards.short_summary: A short, structured reflection walk that works for pairs or small groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata identifies the Labyrinth outside Statton Learning Commons as a circular walkway for meditation and self-reflection, with no admission or purchase listed.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus resource with no admission or purchase listed. Keep the path clear for others and account for weather conditions.

cards.title: Reserve a Quiet Reflection Meetup
cards.subtitle: Interfaith meditation space at 1905 Moore Street
cards.notes: Email Campus Ministry to reserve the room, agree on a quiet group practice, and return prayer rugs and reflection tools neatly afterward.
cards.short_summary: A reservable campus room for a calm, small-group interfaith or mindfulness session.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata presents the Unity House Meditation Room as a campus wellbeing resource reservable through Campus Ministry and lists daily access from 8 a.m. to midnight without a fee.
cards.access_notes: Available daily from 8 a.m. to midnight and reservable by contacting Campus Ministry. The official page lists no reservation charge or purchase requirement.

cards.entity_name: Greenwood Furnace State Park Picnic Area
cards.title: Pack a Pavilion Picnic
cards.subtitle: Free first-come pavilion space in Greenwood Furnace State Park
cards.notes: Pack food from home, claim an unreserved pavilion on arrival, and use the nearby tables and recreation area without making a paid reservation.
cards.short_summary: A bring-your-own picnic meetup in a named state-park grove near Huntingdon.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania DCNR states that unreserved pavilions at Greenwood Furnace State Park are free on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: Picnicking at Greenwood Furnace State Park
cards.access_notes: Unreserved pavilions are free and first-come, first-served. Reserving a pavilion costs money, so use only an available unreserved pavilion for this zero-dollar hang.
